SELECT i.factory AS factory, i.area AS area, i.category_l1_id AS categoryL1Id, COUNT(1) AS issueCount, SUM(CASE WHEN i.submit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closedCount, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1), 2 ) AS closeRate FROM cps_issue i
GROUP BY i.factory, i.area, i.category_l1_id ORDER BY issueCount DESC, i.factory, i.area, i.category_l1_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM cps_issue i
GROUP BY i.factory, i.area, i.category_l1_id ) g

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cps_room r CROSS JOIN cps_inspection_item ii LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, MAX(submitted_at) AS last_record_at FROM cps_room_check_record WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY room_id ) last_rc ON last_rc.room_id = r.id
ii.enabled = 1 AND r.enabled = 1 AND (last_rc.last_record_at IS NULL OR last_rc.last_record_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{gapDays} DAY)) AND r.factory = #{factory} AND r.room_type = #{storageRoomType}

SELECT i.category_l1_id AS categoryL1Id, i.area AS area, a.decision AS decision, a.ai_relation AS aiRelation, COUNT(1) AS sampleCount, MAX(a.created_at) AS lastAt, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT_WS('||', COALESCE(a.reviewer_emp_no, ''), COALESCE(a.reviewer_emp_name, ''), DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'), SUBSTRING(COALESCE(a.reason, ''), 1, 200) ) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC SEPARATOR ';;' ), ';;', 5 ) AS sampleReasons FROM cps_review_adjudication a INNER JOIN cps_issue i ON i.id = a.issue_id
GROUP BY i.category_l1_id, i.area, a.decision, a.ai_relation ORDER BY sampleCount DESC, lastAt DESC, i.category_l1_id, i.area LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM cps_review_adjudication a INNER JOIN cps_issue i ON i.id = a.issue_id
GROUP BY i.category_l1_id, i.area, a.decision, a.ai_relation ) g
